title: P104: sharp upward rank floor and an all-input chart-531 relay repair
body:
## Mathematical result
Every deterministic fixed-schedule normalized binary protocol with these 630 public chart bindings needs at least 4,750 upward rank units. The original word attains all eight dimension-cut ranks. A dual weighting gives the exact relaxed powered price. The proposed 326 → 531 → 1 shortcut on unchanged incidences loses one independent bit, even with nonlinear local recoding. An explicit three-contact repair restores every output and the transpose. For one substitution its raw margin at κ = 0.00389046 is −1.121935400785230928… . Five private clear records change. A physical erasure and signed application for the altered word are open.

## Task and prior work
Campaign follow-up to #7852 and #8041. Canonical main is e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. The 111-port graph is pinned to #8027 at fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4, blob 16f8cafb1c4d139a99a62e46eb40c118e6176c34. Earlier #8036–#8038 test frozen placements and helper/shortcut classes. The stronger cut permits arbitrary binary recoding, and the constructive repair names every altered transfer. The separate five-file #7257 CI prerequisite is commit 0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026. Current scientific package tree 1f2ba1042812604a1a83bc733dc7a6e167ce0546, at branch head ab3680a3e56ff247fef2a76ad9110d571f19ef0d.

## Pricing a rank-preserving fusion
For any rank histogram supported on 1 through 8, its full paid moment equals its total grade minus a weighted sum of the seven excess-rank counts. The weights are the negative second differences of the concave rank tariff. This characterizes exactly which histogram changes pay a saving. At the requested κ, a single grade-preserving two-contact fusion saves at most 2·4ᵗ−8ᵗ = 0.021428347033463130… . Six arbitrary elementary fusions fall short of the raw deficit; seven perfect 4+4 fusions clear it before any extra costs. The source has one chronologically ordered 4+4 pair at the same intermediate chart and 4,227 ordered 2+2 pairs. These are incidence counts. The result does not posit an implementing fusion.

## Validation
From the repository root with CPython 3.12, run `python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-graded-cut-relay-repair`. The original registered replay passed in 3.14 s and 2.90 s on a clean export. The revised registration passed in 3.34 s and its cold committed export in 2.78 s, including two new histogram and incidence corruptions. It verifies the 630×630 forward and transpose actions, all eight cuts, the joint-copy obstruction, retained endpoint charges, and rejects damaged source, receipts, missing-ADD and wrong-oracle controls. This supplies an independently rerunnable normalized binary result. The five original P104 application premises still govern complete multiplication.

## Credit and next experiment
Ali Romman supplied the physical graph and supplier, ToikY raised the earlier chart-510 site, and DreamingOfClouds supplied the #7852 toolkit. Clear1nsight prepared the follow-up with substantial OpenAI Codex research and implementation assistance. The next constructive question is whether two compatible paid intervals can share a real source and retain all causal readers while preserving the saturated grade cuts.
